user.title: Add a Gotify server
user.description: Enter the URL of your Gotify server and an application token. Create the token in Gotify under Apps.

data_description.name: Determines the service name: a name like "My Gotify" becomes notify.my_gotify.
data_description.url: The address where your Gotify server runs, including http or https and, if needed, a port number.
data_description.token: An application token from Gotify (Apps > Create application). A client token will not work.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off only if your server uses a self-signed certificate.
data_description.msg_blacklist: Messages whose text matches one of these entries exactly are discarded instead of sent.

reconfigure.title: Change the Gotify server
reconfigure.description: Renaming also renames the notify service, so any automation using the old name has to be updated.

deprecated_yaml.title: Gotify YAML configuration is being removed
deprecated_yaml.description:
Configuring Gotify in configuration.yaml is no longer supported. Your existing configuration has been imported into the UI automatically.

Remove the Gotify block from the `notify:` section of your configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant to resolve this issue.

deprecated_yaml_import_failed_cannot_con.title: Gotify YAML configuration could not be imported
deprecated_yaml_import_failed_cannot_con.description:
The Gotify configuration for {name} in configuration.yaml could not be imported, because the server could not be reached.

Check whether the server is running and reachable, then restart Home Assistant, or add the server manually under Settings > Devices & services.

deprecated_yaml_import_failed_invalid_au.title: Gotify YAML configuration could not be imported
deprecated_yaml_import_failed_invalid_au.description:
The Gotify configuration for {name} in configuration.yaml could not be imported, because the application token was rejected.

Create a new application token in Gotify and add the server manually under Settings > Devices & services.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Gotify server at {url}.

invalid_auth.message: Gotify rejected the application token. Enter a new token via the repair notification.
